title: SemEval-2026 Task 7: Everyday Knowledge Across Diverse Languages and Cultures

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on culturally grounded Short-Answer Questions (SAQ) and Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQ) created by native speakers from over 30 regions to detect Western-centric misalignment, everyday knowledge gaps, and cultural stereotypes.

Comparing QA accuracy across a wide range of languages, including high-resource, low-resource, and morphologically rich languages, using both English-translated and native-language variants to expose performance disparities and resource-centric model limitations.
